reasons.supplied-word: A word Brenton supplies; the Greek of this verse has no word for it.
reasons.greek-in-the-verse-before: The Greek this English renders stands in the verse before in Swete, so no word of this verse fits it.
reasons.not-in-swete: Swete's Greek of this verse has no word for 'all the nations drink wine'.

leftovers: Brenton says 'how' a second time; the Greek of this verse has one πῶς, which 'How' renders.
Brenton says 'shall inherit' twice; the Greek of this verse has one κληρονομήσουσιν, which 'they shall inherit' renders.
